summary_1line: Safie arrives at the cottage; the creature secretly learns language and history with her lessons, awakening painful awareness of human society and his own isolation.

image_candidates.scene_text: A veiled woman on horseback lifts her black veil before the cottage, revealing her radiant face as Felix rushes toward her in joy.
Hidden in the shadows of the hovel, the creature listens while Safie sits at the old man's feet learning words from Felix.
Alone in the woods at night, the creature reflects in anguish, realizing he is hideous and belongs to no human family.
